source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-18

procedures.title: Dual main cylinder: parts replacement rules
notes: With front discs and rear drums, only the rear-brake outlet has a check valve and spring. Four-wheel disc systems (Corvette) need no check valves.

procedures.title: Main cylinder: remove, overhaul and install
steps: (Removal) Wipe the main cylinder and lines clean; lay dry cloths under it to catch spilled fluid.
Disconnect the brake lines at the cylinder and cover the line ends with clean lint-free material.
Unhook the push rod from the brake pedal.
Unbolt the main cylinder from the firewall and remove it.
Take off the mounting gasket and boot.
Remove the cover, pour out the fluid and pump out the rest by pushing the push rod.
(Disassembly) Clamp the cylinder in a bench vise.
Remove the secondary piston stop bolt from the bottom of the front reservoir.
notes: The disc brake section states that main cylinder service on disc-brake cars is the same as for the Duo-Servo cylinder.
See figure 31 in the manual (exploded view of the drum-brake main cylinder).
